items.prompt: Pawlu ___ mal-kantuniera u ra l-baħar.
items.explanation: Here Pawlu is moving. Dar is the past tense of turning. Dahar means back, and id-dar is the house.

items.prompt: Dan ___ lbieraħ filgħaxija.
items.explanation: Ġara is a verb here because the sentence says when something happened. A female neighbour can be il-ġara.

items.prompt: Iz-zija ___ aħjar wara li straħet.
items.explanation: Ħassha means she felt. Ħassa is lettuce.

items.prompt: Is-sewwieq ___ il-kaxxi minn fuq it-trakk.
items.explanation: Ħatt means he unloaded. Ħadt means I took and ħadd refers to a person in expressions such as ma kien hemm ħadd.

items.prompt: Il-ħanut qiegħed ___ ta' ġebla minn hawn.
items.explanation: Tefgħa is a noun for a throw. Tefgħa ta' ġebla is a short distance, a stone's throw.

items.prompt: Waħħalt ir-ritratt bil-___.
items.explanation: Kolla is the glue used to stick the photo down. Kollha means all of them or all of it, depending on the noun.

items.prompt: Write the missing verb. Qabel ħareġ, ___ d-dawl. (Before leaving, he turned off the light.)
items.answerTranslation: he turned off
items.hint: The spelling depends on whether he turned off the light or threw something.
items.explanation: Tefa means he turned off. Tefa' with a final apostrophe means he threw.

items.prompt: Match each Maltese word with its synonym.
items.explanation: Each pair shares a meaning in this context. The words refer to a driver, hope, a hobby and a holiday.

items.prompt: Replace is-sewwieq with the right form of xufier. Write the whole sentence. Is-sewwieq waqaf ħdejn l-iskola.
items.answerTranslation: The driver stopped near the school.
items.hint: Check the sound at the start of xufier.
items.explanation: The article becomes ix- before x. The meaning of the sentence stays the same.

items.prompt: Use bxara in place of aħbar. Write the whole sentence. Feraħ bl-aħbar it-tajba.
items.answerTranslation: He was pleased with the good news.
items.hint: Check what happens to bl- and to the article before the adjective.
items.explanation: Aħbar starts with a vowel, so it follows bl-. With bxara, use bil-bxara. After bxara ends in a vowel, it-tajba becomes t-tajba.

items.prompt: Replace tqil with a synonym for difficult. Write the whole sentence. Kien eżami tqil.
items.answerTranslation: It was a difficult exam.
items.hint: Look at how tqil is used in the examples about exams.
items.explanation: Diffiċli keeps the meaning of tqil in this sentence about an exam.

items.prompt: Xi tfisser il-kelma Ingliża «junk»?
items.explanation: In the first paragraph, the teacher explains that the English word junk means żibel (rubbish).

items.prompt: Liema ikel fih ħafna melħ skont it-tikketta?
items.explanation: The text says that the crisps contain a lot of salt. It links the biscuits with sugar.

items.prompt: X'fihom il-gallettini skont it-tikketta? Complete the answer. Il-gallettini fihom ___.
items.answerTranslation: The biscuits contain a lot of sugar.
items.hint: Find the sentence about il-gallettini in the second paragraph.
items.explanation: The text says il-gallettini fihom ħafna zokkor. Fihom is plural because it refers to the biscuits.

items.prompt: Fejn issajjar il-patata Lara? Complete the answer. Lara ssajjar il-patata ___.
items.answerTranslation: Lara cooks the potatoes in the oven.
items.hint: Look at the first sentence of the third paragraph.
items.explanation: Lara cooks the potatoes fil-forn (in the oven) at home.

items.prompt: X'jagħżel Daniel għall-brejk?
items.explanation: Daniel takes an apple from his bag for his break. Tuffieħa is the singular for an apple.

items.prompt: F'liema grupp insibu l-ħalib, il-ġobon u l-jogurt?
choices: Jagħmlu parti mill-grupp tal-laħam u l-ħut.
items.explanation: The last paragraph puts milk, cheese and yoghurt in the dairy group, prodotti tal-ħalib.

items.prompt: Choose dar or dahar. Write the whole sentence. Pawlu ___ mal-kantuniera.
items.answerTranslation: Pawlu turned at the corner.
items.hint: Pawlu is doing something at the corner. Choose the verb.
items.explanation: Dar is the verb for “he turned” here. Dahar means the back of a person or thing.

items.prompt: Use xufier in this sentence and change the article. Is-sewwieq waqaf ħdejn l-iskola.
items.answerTranslation: The driver stopped near the school.
items.hint: The article before x uses the same consonant as xufier.
items.explanation: Is-sewwieq and ix-xufier both mean the driver. Before x, use the article ix-.

items.prompt: Skont is-silta, fejn issajjar il-patata Lara? Complete the whole sentence. Lara ssajjar il-patata ___.
items.answerTranslation: Lara cooks the potatoes in the oven.
items.hint: Read the first sentence in the third paragraph.
items.explanation: In the reading, Lara cooks the potatoes in the oven. Fil-forn joins fi and il-forn.

items.prompt: You are writing to Anna. Choose Għażiża or Għeżież and write the whole greeting. ___ Anna, tislijiet mill-Imdina!
items.answerTranslation: Dear Anna, greetings from Mdina!
items.hint: Think of one female recipient.
items.explanation: Għażiża is the feminine singular greeting. Għeżież is used to greet several people.

items.prompt: Choose qatt or qadd. Write the whole sentence. ___ ma rajt borra f'Malta.
items.answerTranslation: I've never seen snow in Malta.
items.hint: Look for the word that works with ma rajt to mean never.
items.explanation: Qatt ma means never. Qadd refers to the waist.

items.prompt: Skont is-silta, x'fihom il-gallettini? Complete the whole sentence. Il-gallettini fihom ___.
items.answerTranslation: The biscuits contain a lot of sugar.
items.hint: Look for the biscuits in the second paragraph, where the class reads the labels.
items.explanation: The biscuits have a lot of sugar in the text. The crisps are the food the text links with salt.

items.prompt: Use bxara instead of aħbar and adapt the articles. Write the whole sentence. Feraħ bl-aħbar it-tajba.
items.answerTranslation: He was pleased with the good news.
items.hint: Bxara starts with a consonant and ends with a vowel. Check both parts of the phrase.
items.explanation: Use bil-bxara with the consonant b. After the final a in bxara, the i in it-tajba drops.

items.prompt: Use daq and daqq once each. Write the whole sentence. ___ il-kejk u mbagħad ___ il-pjanu.
items.answer: Daq il-kejk u mbagħad daqq il-pjanu
items.answerTranslation: He tasted the cake and then played the piano.
items.hint: With the cake he tasted something. With the piano he played something.
items.explanation: Daq with one q means he tasted. Daqq with two means he played an instrument.

items.prompt: Skont is-silta, liema grupp hu dan? Complete the whole sentence. Il-ħalib, il-ġobon u l-jogurt huma ___.
items.answer: Il-ħalib, il-ġobon u l-jogurt huma prodotti tal-ħalib
items.answerTranslation: Milk, cheese and yoghurt are dairy products.
accepted: Il-ħalib, il-ġobon u l-jogurt huma prodotti tal-ħalib
Il-ħalib, il-ġobon u l-jogurt huma l-prodotti tal-ħalib
Il-ħalib, il-ġobon u l-jogurt jagħmlu parti mill-grupp tal-prodotti tal-ħalib
Il-ħalib il-ġobon u l-jogurt huma prodotti tal-ħalib
items.hint: The class names this group in the last paragraph.
items.explanation: Prodotti tal-ħalib means dairy products, the group that includes milk, cheese and yoghurt.

items.prompt: Use a synonym for tqil that means difficult. Write the whole sentence. Kien eżami tqil.
items.answerTranslation: It was a difficult exam.
items.hint: Tqil describes difficulty when it refers to the exam in this sentence.
items.explanation: Diffiċli means difficult. With an exam, tqil can have that same meaning.

items.prompt: It was Sunday and nobody was in the shop. Use Ħadd and ħadd. Write the whole sentence. Nhar il-___, ma kien hemm ___ fil-ħanut.
items.answer: Nhar il-Ħadd, ma kien hemm ħadd fil-ħanut
items.answerTranslation: On Sunday, nobody was in the shop.
accepted: Nhar il-Ħadd, ma kien hemm ħadd fil-ħanut
Nhar il-Ħadd ma kien hemm ħadd fil-ħanut
items.hint: Nhar il- introduces a day. Ma kien hemm introduces the absence of people.
items.explanation: Il-Ħadd is Sunday. In ma kien hemm ħadd, ħadd means nobody because the verb is negative.

items.prompt: Close your postcard to several colleagues. Choose narak or narawkom and write the whole line. Għeżież kollegi, ___ il-ġimgħa d-dieħla!
items.answerTranslation: Dear colleagues, see you all next week!
items.hint: Several people will read the postcard. Choose the form addressed to more than one person.
items.explanation: Narawkom means we'll see you all. Narak is addressed to one person.

sets.title: Words, reading and postcards · Repeat practice

items.prompt: Choose dar or dahar. Write the whole sentence. Malli wasal ħdejn il-bank, ___ fuq il-lemin.
items.answer: Malli wasal ħdejn il-bank, dar fuq il-lemin
items.answerTranslation: As soon as he got near the bank, he turned right.
accepted: Malli wasal ħdejn il-bank, dar fuq il-lemin
Malli wasal ħdejn il-bank dar fuq il-lemin
items.hint: The last part says which way he went.
items.explanation: Here dar means he turned. Dahar names the back of a person or object.

items.prompt: Use sewwieq in this sentence and change the article. Ix-xufier fetaħ il-bieb tal-karozza.
items.answerTranslation: The driver opened the car door.
items.hint: Sewwieq starts with s. The article echoes that consonant.
items.explanation: Is-sewwieq and ix-xufier mean the driver. Before s, use is-.

items.prompt: Skont is-silta, kif issajjar il-patata Lara d-dar? Write the whole sentence. Meta tkun id-dar, Lara ssajjar il-patata ___.
items.answer: Meta tkun id-dar, Lara ssajjar il-patata fil-forn
items.answerTranslation: When she is at home, Lara cooks potatoes in the oven.
accepted: Meta tkun id-dar, Lara ssajjar il-patata fil-forn
Meta tkun id-dar Lara ssajjar il-patata fil-forn
items.hint: Find Lara's cooking method in the third paragraph.
items.explanation: The text describes how Lara cooks potatoes at home. Fil-forn means in the oven.

items.prompt: You are writing to Rosa. Choose Għażiża or Għeżież and write the whole greeting. ___ Rosa, tislijiet mill-Belt!
items.answerTranslation: Dear Rosa, greetings from Valletta!
items.hint: Rosa is one female recipient.
items.explanation: Għażiża addresses one woman. Għeżież addresses a group.

items.prompt: Choose qatt or qadd. Write the whole sentence. ___ ma rkibt lanċa bil-lejl.
items.answerTranslation: I've never been on a ferry at night.
items.hint: Think of the expression for never.
items.explanation: Qatt ma before the verb means never. Qadd refers to the waist.

items.prompt: Skont is-silta, x'hemm fil-gallettini? Write the whole sentence. Skont it-tikketta, fil-gallettini hemm ___.
items.answer: Skont it-tikketta, fil-gallettini hemm ħafna zokkor
items.answerTranslation: According to the label, the biscuits contain a lot of sugar.
accepted: Skont it-tikketta, fil-gallettini hemm ħafna zokkor
Skont it-tikketta fil-gallettini hemm ħafna zokkor
items.hint: Read the last sentence of the second paragraph.
items.explanation: The label in the story says the biscuits contain ħafna zokkor (a lot of sugar).

items.prompt: Use aħbar instead of bxara and adapt the articles. Write the whole sentence. Ħadna pjaċir bil-bxara t-tajba.
items.answerTranslation: We were pleased with the good news.
items.hint: Aħbar starts with a vowel and ends with a consonant. Change both articles.
items.explanation: Use bl-aħbar before a vowel. The final r in aħbar is followed by the full article in it-tajba.

items.prompt: Use daq and daqq once each. Write the whole sentence. Waqt il-festa, Mark ___ is-soppa u wara ___ il-kitarra.
items.answer: Waqt il-festa, Mark daq is-soppa u wara daqq il-kitarra
items.answerTranslation: At the feast, Mark tasted the soup and later played the guitar.
accepted: Waqt il-festa, Mark daq is-soppa u wara daqq il-kitarra
Waqt il-festa Mark daq is-soppa u wara daqq il-kitarra
items.hint: One verb goes with food and the other goes with a musical instrument.
items.explanation: Daq with one q means he tasted. Daqq with two means he played an instrument.

items.prompt: Complete the whole sentence with the three examples in story order. Il-grupp tal-prodotti tal-ħalib jinkludi ___, ___ u ___.
items.answer: Il-grupp tal-prodotti tal-ħalib jinkludi ħalib, ġobon u jogurt
items.answerTranslation: The dairy group includes milk, cheese and yoghurt.
accepted: Il-grupp tal-prodotti tal-ħalib jinkludi ħalib, ġobon u jogurt
Il-grupp tal-prodotti tal-ħalib jinkludi ħalib ġobon u jogurt
Il-grupp tal-prodotti tal-ħalib jinkludi l-ħalib, il-ġobon u l-jogurt
items.hint: Look for the three examples in the last paragraph.
items.explanation: The story lists ħalib, ġobon and jogurt as dairy products.

items.prompt: Use a synonym for tqil that means difficult. Write the whole sentence. Sibt it-test tqil.
items.answerTranslation: I found the test difficult.
items.hint: The sentence is about doing a test.
items.explanation: Diffiċli describes how hard the test was. In this context tqil has the same meaning.

items.prompt: It was Sunday and we saw nobody in the square. Use Ħadd and ħadd. Write the whole sentence. Nhar il-___, ma rajna lil ___ fil-pjazza.
items.answer: Nhar il-Ħadd, ma rajna lil ħadd fil-pjazza
items.answerTranslation: On Sunday, we did not see anybody in the square.
accepted: Nhar il-Ħadd, ma rajna lil ħadd fil-pjazza
Nhar il-Ħadd ma rajna lil ħadd fil-pjazza
items.hint: The first form names a day. The second refers to people.
items.explanation: Nhar il-Ħadd means on Sunday. Ma rajna lil ħadd means we didn't see anybody.

items.prompt: Close your postcard to several friends. Choose narak or narawkom and write the whole line. Għeżież ħbieb, ___ dalwaqt!
items.answerTranslation: Dear friends, see you all soon!
items.hint: Match the ending to a group of people.
items.explanation: Narawkom addresses several people. Narak addresses one person.

items.prompt: Say what the first packet contains. Write the whole sentence. Il-pakkett ___ il-patata.
items.answerTranslation: The packet contains the crisps.
items.hint: Pakkett is masculine.
items.explanation: Use fih with the masculine singular subject il-pakkett. The packet contains the crisps.

items.prompt: Use the numbers on the labels. Complete the whole sentence. Il-patata ___ aktar melħ ___.
items.answerTranslation: The crisps contain more salt than the biscuits.
items.hint: Patata is feminine. Use minn with il-gallettini.
items.explanation: Use fiha with il-patata. The crisps have 1.4 g of salt per 100 g and the biscuits 0.4 g. Minn + il-gallettini becomes mill-gallettini.

items.prompt: Use the numbers on the labels. Complete the whole sentence. Il-gallettini ___ aktar zokkor ___.
items.answerTranslation: The biscuits contain more sugar than the crisps.
items.hint: Gallettini is plural. Use minn with il-patata.
items.explanation: Use fihom with il-gallettini. The biscuits have 18 g of sugar per 100 g and the crisps 2 g. Minn + il-patata becomes mill-patata.

sets.title: Find the clue in the sentence

items.prompt: In Il-ġara tagħna ħarġet filgħodu, which word next to ġara tells you it refers to a person?
items.explanation: Tagħna means our. Il-ġara tagħna means our neighbour. Here ġara is a noun.

items.prompt: In Pawlu daq is-soppa, which expression helps you choose daq with one q?
items.explanation: The object is soup. Daq means he tasted it. Daqq is used for playing an instrument.

items.prompt: In which sentence can you use diffiċli to keep the meaning of tqil or tqila?
items.explanation: A difficult exam can be eżami tqil or eżami diffiċli. With a bag or a box, tqila describes its weight.

items.prompt: Which word completes the sentence about the weight of a bag? Il-borża mimlija kotba hija ___.
items.explanation: Tqila means heavy and agrees with the feminine noun il-borża.

items.prompt: Which phrase did you hear that shows dar names a place?
items.explanation: Quddiem id-dar means in front of the house. Here dar names a place.

items.prompt: Which phrase did you hear after dar that shows the driver's direction?
items.explanation: Fuq ix-xellug means to the left. Here dar describes the driver's movement.

items.prompt: Which food did Pawlu taste in the recording?
items.explanation: The object is is-soppa (soup), so daq is the verb for tasted.

items.prompt: Which instrument did Pawlu play in the recording?
items.explanation: Il-kitarra means the guitar. Daqq with two q's means he played it.

items.prompt: Kemm għandhom ħin qabel tibda l-logħba?
items.answerTranslation: They have ten minutes.
items.explanation: Ruben says they have ten minutes before the game.

items.prompt: Kemm jiswa l-ħobż bil-ġobon?
items.answerTranslation: The bread with cheese costs two euros.
items.explanation: The bread with cheese costs two euros. The crisps cost one euro.

items.prompt: X'se tixrob Nadja? Complete the whole sentence. Nadja se tixrob ___.
items.answerTranslation: Nadja will drink water.
items.explanation: She asks for a bottle of water. Flixkun ilma means a bottle of water.

items.prompt: Għaliex Nadja se tieħu l-ħobż bil-ġobon?
choices: Għax Ruben se jaqsam il-gallettini magħha.
Għax il-ħobż bil-ġobon jiswa inqas mill-patata.
Għax illum għadha ma kielet xejn.
items.answer: Għax illum għadha ma kielet xejn.
items.answerTranslation: Because she hasn't eaten anything today.
items.explanation: Nadja explains that she hasn't eaten anything today. She also asks for water.

items.prompt: Choose a greeting for a postcard to your friend Paul.
items.answerTranslation: Dear Paul,
items.explanation: Għażiż addresses one man. Għażiża addresses one woman and Għeżież addresses a group.

items.prompt: You are writing to the whole team at work. Choose the greeting for the group.
items.answerTranslation: Dear colleagues,
items.explanation: Kollegi is plural here, so the adjective in the greeting is Għeżież.

items.prompt: Tell one friend that you'll show them the photos tomorrow. Write the whole sentence. Għada ___ ir-ritratti.
items.answerTranslation: Tomorrow I'll show you the photos.
items.hint: Choose nurik or nurikom.
items.explanation: Nurik addresses one person. Nurikom addresses several people.

items.prompt: You're writing on your own to several colleagues. Say “I'll see you all on Monday.” Write the whole sentence. ___ it-Tnejn.
items.answerTranslation: I'll see you all on Monday.
items.hint: Choose narak, narakom or narawkom.
items.explanation: In narakom, n- marks one speaker and -kom addresses several people. Narawkom means we'll see you all.

items.prompt: Write a closing to one friend. Complete the whole line. Inselli ___.
items.answerTranslation: Best wishes to you.
items.hint: Choose għalik or għalikom.
items.explanation: Għalik is the form for one person. Għalikom is the form for several people.

items.prompt: Close a postcard to all your colleagues. Complete the whole line. Inselli ___.
items.answerTranslation: Best wishes to you all.
items.hint: Choose għalik or għalikom.
items.explanation: Use għalikom for the whole group. The ending -kom refers to several people.

items.prompt: Choose a greeting for a postcard to your friend Susanna.
items.answerTranslation: Dear Susanna,
items.explanation: Għażiża is the feminine singular greeting.

items.prompt: Choose a greeting for a postcard to a group of friends.
items.answerTranslation: Dear friends,
items.explanation: Ħbieb is plural, so the greeting uses Għeżież.

items.prompt: Write to one friend. Say you'll show them the tickets when you arrive. Write the whole sentence. Meta nasal, ___ il-biljetti.
items.answerTranslation: When I arrive, I'll show you the tickets.
items.hint: Choose nurik or nurikom.
items.explanation: Nurik is used with one reader, whether the reader is male or female.

items.prompt: You are the only sender. Tell the other volunteers you'll see them all on Wednesday. Write the whole sentence. ___ l-Erbgħa.
items.answerTranslation: I'll see you all on Wednesday.
items.hint: Choose narak, narakom or narawkom.
items.explanation: Narakom matches one sender greeting several readers.

items.prompt: Reply to a postcard from your aunt. Complete the whole closing line. Inselli ___, zija.
items.answerTranslation: Best wishes to you, Auntie.
items.hint: Choose għalik or għalikom.
items.explanation: Zija is one recipient, so use għalik.

items.prompt: Reply to all the friends you travelled with. Complete the whole closing line. Inselli ___, ħbieb.
items.answerTranslation: Best wishes to you all, friends.
items.hint: Choose għalik or għalikom.
items.explanation: Use għalikom when you're addressing several friends.
